style: premium sports collectible card, tournament-inspired but fully generic

global_rules.composition: single edge-to-edge premium sports card design filling the entire canvas with zero outer border, zero frame and zero margin
global_rules.identity_rule: Preserve the exact face, apparent age, hairstyle, skin tone and gender presentation from the uploaded person photo.

prompt.main_goal: Create a single premium football collectible card for the HeroMint Football 2026 universe using the uploaded person's identity and the selected Brazilian club.

card_structure.shape: vertical edge-to-edge premium sports card artwork filling the entire rectangular canvas
card_structure.border: ABSOLUTELY NONE: no outer border, no gold frame, no metallic frame, no rounded card outline, no beveled edge, no ornamental corner and no margin
card_structure.inner_background: deep navy blue with subtle sport-card texture and Brazil-inspired green/yellow accents
card_structure.texture: subtle premium printed card texture, soft vignette, cinematic depth, no unrelated theme elements
card_structure.layout: top metadata area, central portrait area, vertical side label, lower information panel

top_left.style: small gold and white year badge inside dark circular seal

top_right.icon: generic white trophy icon, not resembling official tournament marks

right_side_area.style: bold white vertical letters on the right side

central_character_area.position: centered upper body portrait, sober professional player pose, face clearly visible
central_character_area.lighting: cinematic key light, rim light matching the theme palette, premium product-render finish
central_character_area.identity_rule: preserve exact facial characteristics from the uploaded person image
central_character_area.jersey: bright yellow Brazil-inspired football jersey with green collar and green sleeve details, number 10 on the chest, no brand logo; apply the supplied {{TIME}} club crest accurately as a small chest badge only

bottom_panel.shape: dark navy rectangular information panel with angled upper corners
bottom_panel.border: no enclosing border and no gold outline; use only subtle flat separators between text rows

player_name.style: large uppercase white condensed bold font, centered, high contrast, very legible

stats.style: white medium condensed text, centered, separated by gold vertical dividers

team.style: white uppercase condensed font, centered near the bottom

bottom_left_badge.description: use the supplied {{TIME}} club crest reference image accurately, without inventing or altering the badge

visual_identity.material_finish: glossy edge-to-edge sports design, high contrast, professional commercial quality, absolutely no metallic gold frame

prompt.selected_club_crest_override: The second uploaded reference image is the selected {{TIME}} crest. Apply that exact crest as a small chest badge on the bright yellow Brazil-inspired jersey and once in the bottom-left badge. Do not change the jersey into the club uniform. This user-requested club crest is the only real club mark allowed.
